title: PIVOT: Physics-Informed Voting Over Subsystems for Interpretable Anomaly Detection in Industrial Cyber-Physical Systems
description: Research code for anomaly/intrusion detection on Industrial Control Systems (ICS/SCADA). PIVOT decomposes the plant into localized, physically-constrained subsystems, each monitored by a Physics-Informed (PINN) autoencoder, and fuses their alarms with an OR-voting protocol. Removing the signal dilution that limits monolithic detectors raises SWaT F1 from 0.787 to 0.834 at a 0.20% false-alarm rate, and an explainable-AI layer traces each alarm to the stage and sensor that violated an invariant, exposing ground-truth labeling errors in SWaT. Under bounded, non-adaptive white-box evasion (PGD/APGD/C&W) the subsystem array degrades gracefully rather than collapsing. Includes training, evaluation, adversarial benchmarking, USAD/GDN baselines, XAI visualization, and a SCADA monitoring dashboard, evaluated on the SWaT, WADI, and HAI benchmarks.
